# The Greatest Enemy of Any One of Our Truths May Be the Rest of Our Truths[^1]

What is better for us to believe is true _UNLESS THE BELIEF INCIDENTALLY CLASHES WITH SOME OTHER VITAL BENEFIT_. Now in real life what vital benefits is any particular belief of ours most liable to clash with? What indeed except the vital benefits yielded by _OTHER BELIEFS_ when these prove incompatible with the first ones? In other words, the greatest enemy of any one of our truths may be the rest of our truths. Truths have once for all this desperate instinct of self-preservation and of desire to extinguish whatever contradicts them.

[^1]: [[@Pragmatism - William James]]
